description: Get everything needed to decide on one application to your bounty, in one call: the listing (title, description, requirements, completion criteria, skills, pay, location rules, screening settings, and seats filled/open), the applicant's profile (display name, bio, skills, expertise, declared city and country, verified badge, rating, review count, completed jobs), the application (cover letter, availability, screening answers with uploaded files as owner-only download paths, submitted links, mic check, language result), and the outcome so far (`status`; `needsManualReview` when AI screening left the decision to you, with its note in `reason`; for a rejection, `reason` is the message the applicant received). To open a file, GET `https://rentahuman.ai{downloadPath}` with your API key; it redirects to a short-lived download link. Decide with accept_application or reject_application. Owner only.
